# FG-GIT-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_hook_without_its_policy_fails_closed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プッシュの検査を実行できなかったため、プッシュを拒否しました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The push checks could not run, so the push was refused. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Pemeriksaan push tidak dapat dijalankan, sehingga push ditolak. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

The push checks (M3 X8) did not complete as designed. In the hook (`forge hook pre-receive`; the push is refused — fail closed): `reason=env_missing` (no `FORGE_PUSH_CHECK_DIR` / run directory), `policy_unreadable` / `policy_invalid` (the run's policy file written by `forge serve`), `storage` (the repository path from the policy), `quarantine_invalid` (git's `GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY` / `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` are not the repository's quarantine), `stdin_invalid` (git's update lines), `git_failed` (rev-list / cat-file / log failed: `cause_code`), `result_write` (the result file). In `forge serve` after receive-pack exited: `hook_not_run` (git applied refs but no result of this push's hook exists — the hook was skipped, e.g. the hooks directory was replaced or the binary was not executable; the refs were updated unchecked: an alert), `hook_no_result` (git reported `pre-receive hook declined` without a result: the hook crashed or could not start, e.g. `FORGE_PUSH_CHECK_EXE` not runnable), `result_invalid` (unreadable result or another run's nonce), `run_dir` (the run directory could not be created or removed); at start-up `exe_unknown` (`forge serve` could not find its own binary: pushes of that server run unchecked with the empty hooks directory). Timeouts and caps are not this code: they make the scan incomplete (FG-GIT-0024).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

In `forge serve`'s log: one alert event with `error_code=FG-GIT-0023`, `request_id`, `reason`, `repo_id`, `applied` (refs git updated), and the hook's own `detail` / `cause_code` when it wrote a failed result. The pusher saw `remote: FG-GIT-0023 … (request_id: …)`. Check read-only: the hook script `<storage root>/push-hooks/pre-receive` (exactly the generated three lines, mode 0700), that `forge` (the serve binary, `FORGE_PUSH_CHECK_EXE`) runs `forge hook pre-receive` (it prints FG-GIT-0023 `env_missing` without the run directory), and `<storage root>/push-checks/` for stale run directories.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook push-checks: fix the cause named by `reason` (restore the hook script by moving the directory aside and letting forge regenerate it, redeploy a binary that runs, fix permissions of the storage root), then ask the pusher to push again. For `hook_not_run`, the pushed refs were not checked: run the checks by hand on the push's range (runbook push-checks, "unchecked push") and treat a finding like FG-GIT-0021 / FG-GIT-0022.
